behavior: Metadata-only registration and planning; external artifact bytes stay in provider storage.
Exact provider versions are strictly verified and read directly under renewable leases through checks, streaming materialisation, publication and cleanup.
Provider lease loss cancels the build, preserves heads and releases reservations; expiry protects against abandoned crash state.
Replay and pins require the original provider version; old replica bytes never provide an offline fallback.
Schema 10 preserves local/foreign job history and legacy replica bytes while retargeting foreign FKs to metadata.
Public external add/list/show/remove syntax stays unchanged; private provider direct-read service is version 2; worker protocol 1.0 and AST 1 unchanged.
